title: AI Gas Forecaster
tagline: AI-powered gas fee prediction using historical data and LangChain models.
description: AI Gas Forecaster is an on-chain agent that predicts Ethereum gas fees using historical blockchain data and real-time network activity. The agent is built with the Warden Agent Kit and uses LangChain AI models to analyze trends and forecast gas prices. Users can query predictions and receive alerts when gas fees are expected to drop, helping them optimize transactions.
how_its_made: This project integrates the Warden Agent Kit with LangChain AI for machine learning-driven gas fee predictions. The model is trained using historical Ethereum transaction data, and the agent operates on the Warden Protocol blockchain. It leverages Spaces and Rules in Warden to trigger alerts and automate transactions when predicted gas fees meet user-defined thresholds. The backend is built with TypeScript and deployed on Warden Chain.
